title: Happy Birthday, Bhabiee! 🎂💗
message: Happy birthday to my dear someone, my Bhabiee! 🥺💗 I really am grateful for you and for having you in my life. I’m so thankful for all the love, care, patience, and understanding you’ve given me. You’ve been there for me in so many ways, even during the times when I didn’t know how to express what I was feeling. I really appreciate everything you do, even the little things that you might think I don’t notice. I hope you know how special you are to me, Bhabiee. You deserve to be happy, loved, and appreciated not just today, but every single day. Happy birthday, my dear. I love you so much. 💗🎂

title: I Really Am Grateful for You 💖
message: Bhabiee, I really am grateful for you. Thank you for everything you’ve done for me, for all the times you’ve cared for me, listened to me, understood me, and stayed with me. Thank you for continuing to love me even when I’m being difficult, when I overthink, or when I don’t know how to properly express myself. I really appreciate all the effort you give and all the love you show me. Sometimes I may not say it enough, but I notice it, and I’m really thankful for it. You mean so much to me, and I honestly feel lucky that I get to have someone like you in my life. 🥺💗

title: I'm Really Sorry, Bhabiee 🥺
message: And Bhabiee, I’m really sorry for the times I’ve been clumsy, careless, stubborn, or when I’ve done something that hurt you. I know there are times when I could have done better, and I know that sometimes I make mistakes without realizing how they might make you feel. I’m really sorry for those moments. I never mean to hurt you or make you feel like you’re not important to me, because you really are. I’m still learning, and I know I still have a lot to improve about myself. Thank you for being patient with me and for understanding me even when I mess up. I really hope you can forgive me, Bhabiee. I’ll keep trying to be better, not just for myself, but for us too. 🤍

title: I'll Always Be Here for You 🫶
message: I want you to know that no matter what happens, I’ll always be here for you, Bhabiee. When you’re happy, I’ll be happy with you. When you’re sad, I’ll stay and listen to you. When you’re tired or having a hard time, you can always come to me. I may not always know what to say or what to do, but I’ll always try my best to be there for you. You don’t have to go through everything alone. I’ll always be here to support you, listen to you, and remind you that you’re loved. I really hope you know that you can always count on me. 💗

title: I Want More Memories With You ⏳💞
message: I’m really looking forward to all the things we still get to experience together. More laughs, more random conversations, more silly moments, more dates, more memories, and even the little ordinary days that somehow become special because I’m spending them with you. I don’t know what the future will bring, but I really hope I get to be there for more of it with you. I want to keep growing with you, learning with you, and making memories that we can look back on someday. 🥺💗

title: I'll Keep Choosing You 💕
message: Bhabiee, I want you to know that I’ll keep choosing you. I’ll keep trying to understand you, keep trying to love you better, and keep trying to become a better person for myself and for us. I know I’m not perfect, and I know I’ll still make mistakes along the way, but I promise I’ll keep learning from them. Thank you for loving me, for staying with me, and for being someone I can call my dear someone. I really am grateful that it’s you. I hope we continue to grow together and make more beautiful memories. Happy birthday again, Bhabiee. I love you, and I’ll always be here. 🥺💗
